task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm for the red can with decorative label, place the red can with decorative label in the bright yellow basket, and lift the bright yellow basket.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架使用带有装饰标签的红色罐的右臂，将带有装饰标签的红色罐放入亮黄色篮子中，并提起亮黄色篮子。
